_provenance: Published from laquereric/iq@8a23887b59dbea2c295b68bfbe84b55f83c2e653, Development/UseCase/UC_GameSurface/cid/game-push.cid.json, so the seam's CID is fetchable outside a private repo (rule 10).
description: Write access to game sessions. Every PUSH names its intent (operationId); a repeat returns the first receipt and does not run again -- so a retried 'step 30 ticks' never steps 60. Receipts are records on the data plane (iq:game:receipt:<operationId>) and outlive the process.

params.driver: 'host' | 'client' (optional, default host; 'browser' is accepted as client)

params.action: {name, params} closed against the sim's action table (required)

operations.result: ActionRecord with live_applied: false and effective.tick -- recorded now, applied on the next step

params.actions: [{name, params}] (optional, at most 16): recorded at the current tick before stepping, all checked before any is kept -- acting and advancing is one PUSH
params.until: 'event' (optional): stop after the first tick that changes score or lives, or ends the game

operations.result: Observation after stepping, with stopped: 'ticks' | 'event' | 'over'. The host owns the clock.

params.fromTick: integer, must equal the host's tick
params.hash: the browser's state hash at toTick

operations.result: ReplayVerdict: the host replays the batch and reports hostHash and match. A client may be a browser at zero latency or an agent running the sim at its own speed: one PUSH, one gate ask, per batch.

params.session: string (required): a session of a sim with more than one seat (duo)

operations.result: Seat {session, seat, seats}: the next free seat, for an actor holding none (the creator holds seat 0). Co-play, slice 6 step 4.

params.sim: string (required): a sim with more than one seat (duo, squad, duo3)

operations.result: Seat {session, seat, seats, sim, seed, matched}: a seat in the game of that sim waiting longest for a player (matched: joined), or a new game to wait in, seat 0 (matched: created). Decided in the seam's one queue, so two players matched at once meet in one game. A game a peer seam (GAME_PEERS) holds is refused session_elsewhere {seam, session}: the same intent there takes its seat. Refused not_coplay for a sim of one seat. Slice 26.

params.seat: integer (required): the seat to say is away, 0..seats-1

operations.result: SeatAway {session, seat, away, already, tick}: a seat that holds no open lane (its tab crashed, the seam restarted) is away, said by a seat's holder; the clock goes on the present seats' word, and an Advance is appended at once if they are through. Refused seat_present while its lane is open (it can say it leaves itself), not_seated for an actor holding no seat. Slice 12.

params.session: string (required): a co-play session the caller holds a seat of
params.seat: integer (optional, slice 30): another seat, to let go once it has been away -- said away or left, its lane not open -- for GAME_RELEASE_MS; omitted, the caller's own

operations.result: SeatGiven {session, seat, tick, freed?}: the caller's seat given up for good -- away and free, the game on the other seats' word and waiting again (session.list); the next to join or match takes it over where it is, its ship and its lane numbered on. A lane of the giver's still open is closed seat_given, and a ticket issued before writes nothing. Refused not_seated for an actor holding no seat. Slice 27. Another seat's (slice 30): freed: true, its record naming who freed it (by); refused seat_present while its lane is open or it is not away, seat_held before GAME_RELEASE_MS (because: awayMs, releaseMs), seat_free for a seat nobody holds.

params.session: string (required): a co-play session the caller holds a seat of

operations.result: Rematch {session, from, seat, seats, sim, seed, made}: the next game after this one -- the same sim, a new seed, every seat's holder seated in the seat it held (a seat given up stays free). Made once, by the first holder to ask (made: true); every later ask, from any seat, answers the same game (made: false). The link is recorded (iq:game:session:<id>:next), session.get answers next on this game and prev on that one, and this game is no longer waiting (session.list). Refused not_seated for an actor holding no seat, not_coplay on a solo session. Slice 28.

params.session: string (required): a co-play session the caller holds a seat of
params.actor: string (required): the identity invited (iq:identity:<name>); null withdraws the invitation to seat
params.seat: integer (optional): the free seat to keep (else the one already kept for them, or the first free for anyone); required to withdraw
params.for: integer (optional, slice 34): ms the invitation stands, 1000..86400000 (default GAME_INVITE_MS, 15 min)

operations.result: Invitation {session, seat, actor, seats, until | withdrawn}: a free seat kept for one player -- only they take it (session.join; session.match takes their invitation first, matched: invited), the game is not waiting for anyone else while every free seat is kept, and they find it under their own games (session.list mine: invited). One invitation to a seat: a new one withdraws the last. A seat's record says {actor: null, reserved, by} or {actor: null, withdrawn, by}. Refused not_seated to a stranger, seat_taken for a seat someone holds, already_seated for a player in the game, seats_full when no seat is free; a join with every free seat kept for others is seat_reserved. Slice 33. It lapses at until (slice 34): then the seat is free for anyone, and no longer under the invitee's games; the record carries until, so a restart reads the same lapse, and inviting the same player again renews it.

params.frames: the frame digest the caller speaks (required; sim/frames.js DIGEST)
params.from: integer, the first log position wanted (optional, default 0)
params.roads: in order of preference: 'webtransport' | 'quic' (while cpcp-rt runs) | 'websocket' (always)

operations.result: ChannelTicket {road, lanes (log; log+hint on webtransport and quic), url (websocket, webtransport) or addr+alpn (quic), certSha256 (the relay's pinned certificate), ticket (single-use; never kept in the receipt), until, frames, from, next, write; on co-play, for a seat's holder, seat and lane (its lane's position)}. spec/channels.md (proposed).

reasons_note: unknown_session, unknown_sim, session_driver_mismatch, tick_out_of_order and store_refused are seam reasons proposed here; they are not in the contract taxonomy at the pinned revision. store_refused (failure_layer infrastructure) means the data plane refused the PUSH's records; nothing of the PUSH was kept.
shape_ref: shapes/game-shapes.ttl: the action shapes generate sim/<sim>.actions.js (shapes.py), which checkAction in sim/kit.js enforces -- README finding F5
auth: Every request carries a credential: Authorization: Bearer <token>, or none while the seam binds loopback, which is then the box's (IQ_CARD_TOKEN_FILE / ~/.iq/harness-token). The gate's /whoami names the subject. Every PUSH is asked of the gate's /push as tool card:game:<method> (capability mcp:call:card:game:<method>), journaled in ~/.iq/journal/cards/game.jsonld and observed. A receipt answers only the actor whose intent it was (actor_mismatch); a session is acted on only by its creator (not_session_owner). failure_layer authorization, or infrastructure for seam_unreachable.
